description: This file contains the implementation of a Grain named SlowConsumingGrain and a generic observer class SlowObserver<T> for the Orleans framework. The grain simulates slow consumption behavior by repeatedly requesting to rewind to the first received item, making it useful for testing streaming and resilience features in Orleans.

classes.name: SlowConsumingGrain
classes.description: A grain that repeatedly asks to rewind its stream to simulate slow consumption behavior.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the number of items consumed.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain as a stream consumer.

classes.name: SlowObserver
classes.description: A generic observer class that keeps asking for the first item received to mimic slow consuming.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream items and repeatedly asks to rewind to the first item.
